summary: Tested Import Rollback feature end-to-end for deployment roster CSV imports. Backend (4/4 pytest PASS): rollback requires auth, 404 for missing history, full happy-path (import 3 entries -> added_entry_ids stored -> POST /rollback deletes entries -> history marked rolled_back with rolled_back_count=3 -> second rollback returns 400), and 400 for imports with no added_entry_ids (duplicate-only import). Frontend (TIFMAS flow verified with Playwright): Import CSV of 3 unique names, switched to Import History tab, Undo button (data-testid=rollback-btn-<id>) visible for that import, clicking opens 'Undo CSV Import' dialog with correct entry count (3), confirming delete removes entries from roster and displays 'Rolled Back' badge; Undo button removed for that row. EMTF page shares identical logic (backend endpoint is common). All acceptance criteria from the review request are met.

backend.test_import_stores_added_ids_and_rollbac: PASS - import stores added_entry_ids[3]; POST rollback deletes 3 roster rows; history marked rolled_back=true, rolled_back_count=3; second rollback returns 400
backend.test_rollback_history_without_added_entr: PASS - duplicate-only import produces added=0/added_entry_ids=[]; rollback returns 400

frontend.Import History shows Undo button after n: PASS - rollback-btn-<id> present with 3 entries added
frontend.Undo dialog opens with correct details: PASS - shows Import Date, Filename, Entries to Delete=3, title 'Undo CSV Import'
frontend.Entries removed from roster after rollba: PASS - TEST_UI_RB_*_A/B/C not present in roster tab
frontend.N/A shown for imports with no added entr: VERIFIED VIA CODE (line 887 in TIFMASRankPage.js) - Not e2e clicked but logic covered by backend test #4

action_items: LOW: Add data-testid to the rollback confirmation button in the Undo dialog (currently no testid on the 'Delete N Entries' button in both TIFMASRankPage.js line ~1195 and EMTFRankPage.js) for easier automation. Suggest data-testid='rollback-confirm-btn'.
LOW: Consider adding data-testid='rolled-back-badge-<id>' on the 'Rolled Back' badge (TIFMAS line 872, EMTF equivalent) to disambiguate multiple badges when counting.
critical_code_review_comments: TIFMASRankPage.js (~1213 lines) and EMTFRankPage.js are near-duplicates for import/rollback/history/cleanup logic. Extract shared behavior into a hook (e.g. useRosterImport) or module to eliminate the >50 lines of duplicated rollback logic (openRollbackDialog/handleRollback/dialog JSX).

Backend rollback endpoint deletes entries but does NOT clean up references from downstream collections (deployments/deployment_history) that may reference deleted deployment_roster ids. If a rolled-back entry was already deployed, referential integrity may break. Consider validating that added_entry_ids have no active deployments before allowing rollback, or cascading appropriately.

Rollback endpoint should also record the user who performed the rollback and expose it in the history GET response (currently stored as rolled_back_by but the frontend Import History table doesn't display it).
The 'Delete N Entries' confirm button lacks a data-testid, making it harder to test destructive flows deterministically.
Frontend guard `entry.added > 0 && entry.added_entry_ids?.length > 0` is correct, but is duplicated in TIFMAS and EMTF - another DRY violation.
seed_data_creation: Test creates TEST_RB_* and TEST_UI_RB_* deployment_roster rows and cleans them up via the rollback flow itself. A single TEST_RB_DUP_* row is created and later rolled back at end of test_rollback_history_without_added_entry_ids. Net roster impact: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Rollback feature is fully working. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_import_rollback.py is green (4/4). If adding more coverage: test rollback in a multi-tenant context (ensure tenant_id scoping prevents cross-tenant rollback), and test that deployments/history referencing rolled-back roster ids are handled (currently no cascade).
